svg.title: DurpDeploy architecture, including remote agents
svg.desc: The server coordinates ordered deployment steps. Server containers and remote agents run scripts. Agents initiate pinned mTLS connections and return logs and results.
svg.text: Server orchestration, script execution, and remote agents

text.tspan: Agent host — repeated across the fleet

svg.text: Agents initiate runtime connections. Initial pairing uses a temporary agent listener.
Remote steps fan out to matching agents. The runner waits for every run to succeed.
